Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 27,990.00 and is NOT summed as an increment (utah is a per-period regime). The sum closes ONLY WITH the in-kind row (p2 row 1, Leonard Lee 3,000.00, In-Kind box ticked): monetary-only gives 21,800.00 against a stated 24,800.00, so this filing's stated contribution total INCLUDES in-kind.

The single in-kind gift (Leonard Lee, yard signs, 3,000.00, 6/20/22) is entered TWICE, once as a contribution (p2 row 1) and once as an offsetting expenditure of the identical amount and date (p4 row 5), each with the In-Kind checkbox ticked, and BOTH stated Column-equivalents (Box B and Box D) include it. escalation_note: Two Schedule A amount cells on p3 were escalated to a tight 900 dpi --value crop. (1) p3 row 2 (Narwahl Homes) — the leading digits are written with a bridging horizontal stroke that reads at 200 dpi as a possible strike-out; the 900 dpi crop renders '3500.00' with no strike, and the page's own arithmetic is unique on it (the other seven rows sum to 6,300.00 against a printed subtotal of 9,800.00 once row 6 is settled). (2) p3 row 6 (Lowell Nelson) — the loops read equally as 600.00 or 6000.00 at full page; the 900 dpi crop renders six-zero-zero followed by this filer's comma-form decimal and two zeros, and the arithmetic is decisive and UNIQUE: the seven other rows sum to 9,200.00 against the printed 9,800.00, so the cell is 600.00 (6000.00 would put the sheet 5,400.00 over its own printed subtotal). Arithmetic closure outranks glyph reading (GOTCHAS / Rhodes reversal). No figure was nudged anywhere on this filing; every one of the four printed subtotals and both grand totals reproduce to the cent.
